description: Samsung is reportedly rolling out the stable One UI 8.5 update for Galaxy Z Fold 5 and Galaxy Z Flip 5 smartphones in India and other global markets. The update reportedly has firmware versions F946BXXU6GZE2 and F731BXXU6GZE3. The update reportedly includes the April 2026 security patch. It is around 4GB in size. Additionally, the One UI 8.5 is now said to be available for the Samsung Galaxy A26 in Guatemala.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 5, Galaxy Z Flip 5 Reportedly Receive One UI 8.5 Stable Update in India

description: Scientists have discovered 77 rare red quasars hidden behind cosmic dust using NASA’s SPHEREx telescope. The findings support theories linking galaxy mergers to rapid black hole growth and galaxy evolution.
title: Scientists Discover 77 Rare Red Quasars Hidden Behind Cosmic Dust

description: Apple’s upcoming iPhone operating system version will reportedly support third-party media-casting protocols. Apple’s iOS 27 is said to support AirPlay alternatives by default to meet new EU requirements. The company, to comply with the requirements of the European Union’s Digital Markets Act, is building support for third-party AirPlay streaming alternatives in iOS 27.  This update will let third-party apps, such as Google Cast, be set as the default solution for beaming video, photos and audio from an Apple device to a speaker or TV.
title: iOS 27 Said to Offer Third-Party AirPlay Alternatives Such as Google Cast to EU Users

description: Xiaomi 17T will be available for purchase in India via Amazon, the smartphone maker revealed on Monday. A dedicated microsite for the smartphone is now live on the e-commerce platform, which also reveals that the Xiaomi 17T will be equipped with a Zeiss-tuned telephoto camera on the back. The telephoto shooter on the Xiaomi 17T will deliver up to 5x optical zoom, up to 10x “optical quality” zoom, and up to 120x digital zoom, enhanced by AI. The camera will also offer a 23mm to 115mm equivalent focal length. Moreover, the lens will feature an f/3.0 aperture.
title: Xiaomi 17T Amazon Availability, Zeiss-Tuned Telephoto Camera Confirmed via Microsite

description: Xiaomi is set to launch the 17T series globally on May 28, while the standard Xiaomi 17T will debut in India on June 4. The lineup is expected to include the Xiaomi 17T and Xiaomi 17T Pro, although only the vanilla model may arrive in India. Leaks suggest AMOLED displays, MediaTek Dimensity chipsets, up to 12GB RAM, and up to 512GB storage. Xiaomi has also teased Leica imaging features, including 5x telephoto photography, while battery capacities could reach 6,500mAh and 7,000mAh respectively.
title: Xiaomi 17T Series Roundup: Launch Date, Expected Price, Specifications

description: Oppo has launched the Enco Air 5s TWS earphones in China alongside the Reno 16 series smartphones. The earbuds feature 12mm dynamic drivers, active noise cancellation, spatial audio, AI-powered call noise reduction, and Bluetooth 6.0 connectivity. They support dual-device pairing, sliding volume controls, and several Oppo ecosystem features. The charging case packs a 530mAh battery, with claimed battery life of up to 48 hours in ANC or transparency modes and up to 100 hours under certain conditions. The earbuds carry an IP55 rating.
title: Oppo Enco Air 5s Launched With 12mm Drivers, Up to 48 Hours Total Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin defended the Ethereum Foundation after growing criticism and several high-profile departures from the organisation. Buterin said the Foundation would continue focusing on censorship resistance, cybersecurity, decentralisation, and long-term research instead of competing with high-throughput blockchain networks.
title: Ethereum Co-Founder Vitalik Buterin Responds to Criticism of Ethereum Foundation

description: Written and directed by Ritesh Rana, Jetlee is a Telugu comedy thriller film that is now available to stream on JioHotstar, in multiple languages.
title: Jetlee Out on OTT: Know Where to Stream This Telugu Comedy Thriller Film Online

description: Dhanush’s latest Tamil film Kara is gearing up for its OTT release on Netflix on May 28, 2026. Set in the 1990s, the movie follows a thief whose life changes after his ancestral land is seized by a bank
title: Kara OTT Release Date Confirmed: When and Where to Watch Dhanush’s Tamil Crime Drama Online?

description: Bad Thoughts Season 2 is a dark comedy anthology series that is now available to stream exclusively on Netflix. It consists of six episodes.
title: Bad Thoughts Season 2 Out on OTT: Know Everything About This Dark Comedy Show

description: The Oppo Pad 6 was launched in China on Monday. The tablet arrives as the successor to the Oppo Pad 5 and sports a 12.1-inch (3,000 × 2,120 pixels) LCD screen with a 144Hz adaptive refresh rate. It is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 9500s processor, coupled with up to 16GB of RAM. The Oppo Pad 6 runs on ColorOS 16 based on Android 16. It has an 8-megapixel rear camera and packs a 10,420mAh battery.
title: Oppo Pad 6 Launched With MediaTek Dimensity 9500s SoC and 10,420mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Realme 16T was launched recently with an 8,000mAh battery and a 50-megapixel rear camera unit. It has a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset. The new phone falls in the same price range as the OnePlus Nord CE 6 5G and Motorola Edge 70 in India. Here’s a comparison between the Realme 16T 5G, OnePlus Nord CE 6 5G, and Motorola Edge 70 to help you pick the best.
title: Realme 16T 5G vs OnePlus Nord CE 6 5G vs Motorola Edge 70: Price in India, Specifications Compared

description: The semiconductor industry is quickly reaching an inflection point. Last year, Samsung began mass production of the initial 2nm node for the Exynos 2600 chipsets. Other players, including TSMC, Qualcomm, MediaTek, and Intel, have also reached significant milestones when it comes to the technology.
title: Huawei Wants to Surpass Moore’s Law Constraints With Its New Scaling System

description: Huawei Nova 16 series will be launched in China on June 1 at 12:08 pm (9:38 am IST). On top of this, the Huawei Nova 16 series is now available for pre-order in China via the Huawei online store. The tech firm has also revealed the design of the Pro model. The phone appears with a quad rear camera system, paired with an LED flash. Three of the camera sensors will be placed inside one circular camera module, while the LED flash and another camera lens appear inside the second module, similar to its predecessor.
title: Huawei Nova 16 Series Launch Date Set for June 1; Design of Upcoming Nova 16 Pro Teased

description: Asus VM441 AiO all-in-one desktop PC has been launched in India. It comes in two storage options and runs on Windows 11 Home. It has a 24-inch full-HD touchscreen display with 100 percent sRGB colour coverage and 300 nits brightness. It offers 178-degree viewing angles. It runs on a Qualcomm Snapdragon X processor.
title: Asus VM441 AiO All-in-One Desktop PC Launched in India With 24-Inch Display, Snapdragon X Processor

description: Apple has appeared in a new FCC filing for an unreleased over-ear headphone model carrying the number A3577, according to a MacRumors report. The documents identify the device as Bluetooth over-ear headphones and confirm it includes a battery, microphone, and wireless connectivity components. Most details remain confidential, leaving its branding and specifications unclear. The model number does not match recent AirPods Max products, leading to speculation that it could belong to the Beats lineup. Apple has not announced a launch timeline.
title: Apple Could Be Developing New Beats or AirPods Headphones, FCC Filing Suggests

description: Google Search’s integrated artificial intelligence (AI) experience, AI Overviews, reportedly suffered a snag over the weekend. When users searched specific keywords, such as “disregard” or “stop,” the dedicated space is said to glitch and stop showing any information. This results in a wide blank space that users reportedly had to scroll past to see any results.
title: Google’s AI Overviews Reportedly Broke Down When Users Searched ‘Disregard’ or ‘Stop’

description: 007 First Light is set to launch on May 27 across PC, PS5, and Xbox Series S/X. Ahead of launch, developer IO Interactive has shared gameplay from the opening mission of the game. The introduction section of 007 First Light and its first mission leaked online over the weekend.
title: IO Interactive Shares 007 First Light Opening Mission Gameplay After Leak

description: Fenwick & West LLP, the law firm that advised collapsed crypto exchange FTX, has agreed to pay $54 million to settle a class action lawsuit filed by former users. The firm was accused of helping FTX conceal the misuse of customer funds and facilitating legal structures tied to the exchange’s operations.
title: FTX Law Firm Fenwick & West Agrees to $54 Million Settlement With Customers

description: Oppo Reno 16 series has been launched in China as the latest addition to the company’s Reno lineup. The series includes two models, dubbed Oppo Reno 16 and Oppo Reno 16 Pro. Both smartphones are set to go on sale in the country via the Oppo China online store. The standard model is offered in Galaxy Purple, Heartbeat, and Moonlight Is Dark (translated from Chinese) colour options. The top-of-the-line model features 16GB of RAM and 1TB of onboard storage. Both smartphones are powered by MediaTek Dimensity chipsets.
title: Oppo Reno 16 Pro With 200-Megapixel Camera, 7,000mAh Battery Launched Alongside Oppo Reno 16: Price, Features

description: Oppo A6c could launch in India as early as this week or next week, according to a recent report. The handset is tipped to start at Rs. 13,999 for the 4GB + 64GB variant, while the 4GB + 128GB option may cost Rs. 16,999. It could initially be sold through offline retail channels. The smartphone is expected to retain its global specifications, including a 6.75-inch 120Hz display, Snapdragon 685 chipset, 6,500mAh battery, Android 15-based ColorOS 15, and a 13-megapixel rear camera.
title: Oppo A6c Price in India, Memory Configurations Leaked Ahead of Anticipated Launch

description: Xiaomi is said to have hiked the prices of two Redmi smartphones in India. Several brands have increased smartphone rates in recent months, citing market conditions. According to a tipster, the Redmi Note 15 5G and the Redmi 15 5G are the latest handsets from the Xiaomi subsidiary to receive a price increase. The revised prices are said to have already come into effect, making multiple variants of both models more expensive than their launch prices.
title: Redmi Note 15 5G, Redmi 15 5G Reportedly Receive Price Hikes in India

description: Ahead of Apple’s annual Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC), a new development has surfaced. As per the report, the Cupertino-based tech giant is readying a new “Gen AI” website, which could be showcased at WWDC 2026. It is currently non-functional and shows a connection timed out error, but the website appears to be registered.
title: Apple Is Reportedly Working on a New Gen AI Website Ahead of WWDC 2026

description: Moto G37, Moto G37 Power, and Moto Buds 2 are now available for purchase in India. The handsets, part of Motorola’s latest G-series lineup, were launched last week, alongside the Moto Buds 2. Both phones are powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6400 chip and run on Android 16. They have a 13-megapixel rear camera. The Moto G37 features a 5,200mAh battery, while the G37 Power has a bigger 7,000mAh cell. The Moto Buds 2, meanwhile, sport a dual 11mm dynamic driver setup.
title: Moto G37, Moto G37 Power Go on Sale in India Alongside Moto Buds 2: Price, Offers

description: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 series will include two models, comprising the South Korean tech giant’s first wide-folding handset, according to a tipster. The leaker claims that the wide-folding phone will be marketed as the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8. Meanwhile, the Galaxy Z Fold 7 successor will reportedly launch as the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra. On top of this, the leaker has shared an image, which reveals the design of the cover display of Samsung’s wide-folding handset.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Series Naming Scheme Leaked; Flagship Model Said to Arrive With ‘Ultra’ Branding

description: Bitcoin traded near $77,300 on Monday as improving geopolitical sentiment helped crypto markets recover from recent volatility. Analysts said easing oil prices and stabilising macro conditions supported the rebound, though ETF outflows and upcoming US inflation data continue to keep traders cautious.
title: Bitcoin Recovers Above $77,300 as Easing Geopolitical Tensions Drive Crypto Market Recovery

description: Streaming free on MX Player, Who’s Your Gynac? Season 2 brings back Dr. Vidushi with more relatable, emotional, and funny moments. With a 7.1 IMDb rating, the show highlights women’s health in a simple and engaging way that connects with viewers of all ages.
title: Who's Your Gynac? Season 2 Now Streaming Online: What You Need to Know

description: Vivo S60 is scheduled to launch in China this week as the successor to the S50, which debuted in December 2025. In recent weeks, the company has been revealing several details about the upcoming handset, including its battery, colourways, and ingress protection. It has surfaced on a benchmarking platform, confirming its moniker and key specifications. The Vivo S60 is expected to be powered by the same Snapdragon SoC as its predecessor. The upcoming handset could ship with 16GB of RAM.
title: Vivo S60 Geekbench Listing Reveals Key Specifications Including Snapdragon 8s Gen 3 Chip, 16GB RAM

description: OnePlus will launch a new Pad series tablet in India soon with an OLED display, a tipster claims. The leaker has also shared the key specifications and features of the tablet, claiming that the OnePlus Pad OLED model will be equipped with an 8.8-inch screen, delivering up to 144Hz of refresh rate. Moreover, it is expected to be powered by Qualcomm’s octa core Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset, which also powers the Oppo Pad Mini. This comes shortly after the company launched its flagship OnePlus Pad 4 in India with a 13.2-inch LCD touchscreen.
title: OnePlus Pad Model With Compact OLED Display to Launch in India Soon, Tipster Claims

description: Epic Games and Psyonix revealed a first look at Unreal Engine 6, powering the "next era" of Rocket League. In a brief teaser video, Psyonix showed off an updated version of Rocket League running on UE6. Epic has not announced a release date for the next iteration of its game engine.
title: Epic Games Unveils Unreal Engine 6 Along With 'New Era' of Rocket League

description: Apple is reportedly redesigning the AirPods settings interface in iOS 27, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. The updated menu is expected to make controls easier to find and organise while reducing complexity created by years of added features. The changes are also said to be coming to iPadOS 27 and macOS 27. Apple is reportedly not planning a dedicated AirPods app, despite user requests. The update could arrive alongside other iOS 27 additions, including Siri, Apple Intelligence, and Genmoji improvements.
title: Apple's iOS 27 Update Said to Offer Revamped AirPods Settings Interface With Simplified Controls Layout

description: In the new edition of the Power On newsletter, Mark Gurman reported that Apple is preparing major upgrades for Genmoji and Image Playground in iOS 27. “Apple’s own models for Genmoji and Image Playground have been improved, so quality is getting a big boost this year,” Gurman said. Apple is expected to expand Image Playground’s capabilities by adding support for additional third-party AI image-generation models.
title: Apple to Introduce Improved Genmoji, Image Playground Upgrades With iOS 27 Update: Mark Gurman

description: Apple is expected to keep watchOS 27 focused on refinements rather than major new features, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. The update will reportedly improve heart-rate tracking on Apple Watch, although details remain unclear. Gurman also said Apple's AI-powered health coaching project, internally known as Project Mulberry, may not be ready for the initial watchOS 27 release. The company is still believed to be developing a redesigned Health app, while watchOS 27 could also bring performance improvements, a new watch face, and additional Apple Intelligence features.
title: Apple's AI-Powered Health Coach Said to Face Delay, Might Arrive After watchOS 27 Release

description: Vivo Y600 Turbo launched in China with a Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset, paired with up to 12GB of RAM and 512GB of storage. It has a dual camera unit on the back, highlighted by a 50-megapixel primary sensor. It has a 9,000mAh battery with 90W fast charging support. The new phone is offered in three colour options.
title: Vivo Y600 Turbo Launched With 9,000mAh Battery, Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 SoC: Price, Specifications

description: The Xiaomi 17T series is scheduled to be launched in select global markets on June 28. The handsets are expected to be the first ‘T’ series models launched by the brand since the Xiaomi 11T Pro, which debuted in January 2022. Ahead of their anticipated debut, the pricing of the Xiaomi 17T and Xiaomi 17T Pro has been leaked by a tipster. Both handsets are expected to be available in two RAM and onboard storage configurations.
title: Xiaomi 17T, Xiaomi 17 Pro Price, Storage Configurations Leak Ahead of Global Launch

description: Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ will be launched in India on June 4, the smartphone maker has announced. The upcoming smartphone is set to arrive as the fourth model in the lineup, joining the Motorola Edge 70, Edge 70 Pro, and Edge 70 Fusion. The handset is confirmed to go on sale in the country via Flipkart. The Edge 70 Pro+ will be offered in three colour options, dubbed Pantone Chicory Coffee, Pantone Stormy Sea, and Pantone Zinfandel. Moreover, it will carry a triple rear camera setup, led by a 50-megapixel main shooter.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ India Launch Date Announced; Periscope Telephoto Rear Camera Confirmed

description: Xiaomi is said to be gearing up to expand its wearable portfolio with a new Smart Band model. According to a report, a new wearable has surfaced in certification databases in Taiwan and Singapore, hinting at an impending global launch. Although the listing does not reveal the product’s moniker or any of its specifications, the numbering suggests it could belong to one of the models in the purported Smart Band 11 series.
title: Xiaomi Smart Band 11 Active Reportedly Sighted on IMDA, NCC Certification Sites Ahead of Launch
